title: Data Science/ Data Analytics Intern
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for enthusiastic Data Science Interns who are interested in learning and building a career in data science and analytics. Candidates will get practical exposure to data analysis, Python, machine learning, and real\-world projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Work with datasets and perform data analysis

Learn and apply Python for data science

Assist in data cleaning and visualization

Work with basic machine learning concepts

Prepare reports and insights from data

Participate in real\-time projects and team activities

Eligibility:

Candidates who have completed \+2, Diploma, B.Tech, or any Degree

Students and freshers can apply

Basic computer knowledge

Interest in Data Science, Python \& Analytics

Good communication and problem\-solving skills

What We Provide:

Practical training

Real\-time project exposure

Mentorship from industry professionals

Certificate upon completion

Career guidance and job assistance

Opportunity to develop industry\-ready skills

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Data Science & Data Analytics Faculty
description:
We are looking for a passionate and knowledgeable **Data Science \& Data Analytics Faculty** to join our academic/training team. The candidate will be responsible for delivering engaging theoretical and practical sessions in Data Science, Data Analytics, Python, SQL, Statistics, Machine Learning, and Data Visualization.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to explain complex concepts in a simple, practical, and industry\-oriented manner.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver classroom and/or online training in Data Science and Data Analytics.
* Develop and deliver lectures, practical sessions, assignments, quizzes, and projects.
* Teach topics such as:
* Python for Data Science
* SQL and Database Concepts
* Statistics and Probability
* Data Cleaning and Data Preprocessing
* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Pandas, NumPy and Scikit\-learn
* Data Visualization using Power BI/Tableau
* Machine Learning fundamentals
* Regression, Classification and Clustering
* Real\-world Data Analytics projects
* Guide students through hands\-on projects and case studies.
* Prepare course materials, presentations, practical exercises, and assessments.
* Evaluate student performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Mentor students on projects, portfolios, and industry\-oriented skills.
* Stay updated with current Data Science, Analytics, AI, and Machine Learning trends.
* Support students in developing job\-ready technical and analytical skills.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Python and SQL**.
* Good understanding of **Statistics and Data Analytics**.
* Knowledge of **Machine Learning concepts and algorithms**.
* Experience with **Pandas, NumPy and Scikit\-learn**.
* Knowledge of **Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools**.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to teach technical concepts using practical examples and real\-world datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field**.
* Previous experience as a Data Science/Data Analytics trainer, faculty member, mentor, or industry professional is preferred.
* Industry certifications or relevant professional experience will be an added advantage.

What We Offer

* Professional and collaborative teaching environment.
* Opportunity to work with students and aspiring Data Science professionals.
* Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person
